items.heading: Write the Real Entry Step
items.text: Write the Real Entry Step Write the real entry step and date for each. Open the official exam site and note eligibility, marks needed and application window. Dates change every year.

The page shows what remains, why each other route is hidden, and which filter to relax to see more.

items.heading: Pick Three Rows From
items.text: Pick three rows from the chart. Do not compare every route. Choose one you are drawn to, one your family suggests and one safe route that pays sooner.

items.heading: Do One Small Task From
items.text: Do one small task from each route. Write ten lines of code, sketch a poster, read a bare act on law, or make a mini budget. Notice which one you keep doing without being asked.

items.heading: Talk to Two People Inside
items.text: Talk to two people inside each route. One senior student and one working person. Ask what the boring 80% of the work is and what they would do differently at 17.

items.heading: Drop One Route in Writing
items.text: Drop one route in writing. Removing a route makes the decision real. Take as long as you genuinely need, some students finish in a few weeks and others need a couple of months.
